Author: sweatpotato13
Name: Doman Mahjong Sensei
Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and tells you the best discard, or plays the match for you. Fork of XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoMahjongSolver adding Korean-client support.
Changelog: v0.1.2.3: First release of this fork. Call prompts are matched per locale instead of against hardcoded English, so pon, chi, kan, riichi, tsumo and ron fire on a Korean client instead of being passed. Two fixes that apply everywhere: the shanten calculator no longer calls a dead wait tenpai when the hand holds all four copies of a tile, and the Doman minimum is one han, not two, so legal one-han wins are taken. Telemetry removed.
